name: Information Technology University (ITU), Lahore
_note: Weights from ITU 'Norms & Criteria' (updated 2026-08-12), Selection Criteria. Only BS Computer Science / BS Artificial Intelligence give the Matric vs Inter split; other BS programs give one 'Academic Record' weight (EE/SE/CE 50 + test 50; M&T/FinTech 40 + 60; Economics with Data Science 50 + 50) without saying how it is formed, so no formula is stored for them. No closing merit published. Merit (Fall 2025): ITU publishes each BS merit list as an HTML table of offered candidates with a MERIT score and no closing figure; each row here is the lowest MERIT in the latest list found per program (round 2 where ITU ran one; round 1's last list kept as 'Round 1 last list'). Derived and checked by script against the saved list pages on 1 Nov 2026 (draft had BS Computer Engineering 77.09; the list's lowest is 77). Only BS CS/AI feed the predictor (the only programs with a stored formula). Earlier lists in a round may have closed lower or higher; ITU does not say which list is final.
